findings.detail: AC4-untracked-par-level-shown requires a genuine nullable par_level column on stock_records (feature-request.md: 'Optional detail that is not tracked (par level)'; AC4's architectural_notes: 'Par level is a nullable domain field'), which no prior story's schema/PI covers, so this story must add a new additive Alembic migration. NFR-F1-durability-migrations requires a real-branch migration-reversibility fitness test for every additive schema migration (mirroring T12/PI4 for the original stock_records migration), but the S3 test-list (T18-T22) has no such item, only T22's layering fitness test. Add a kind:"fitness" item (e.g. @pytest.mark.migration downgrade -1 / upgrade head on the par_level-adding revision, asserting pre-existing rows survive) so this migration is defended before build.
